content.intro: This lesson covers Attribute-Like Procedural Macros. It sits in Module 19, Macros and Metaprogramming, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Attribute-Like Procedural Macros matters when you work with code generation and expansion. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Macros transform token streams before or during compilation, allowing patterns that ordinary functions cannot express. Prefer ordinary functions when they are sufficient, and test macro expansions as public API.
